title: Rav Assi bar Chama

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Kamma 93a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.93a.7-10), saying to Rava: “Thus said Rav Sheshet.” Dikdukei Soferim reads: “Rav Yosef bar Chama (Rava’s father) said to Rabbah: Thus said Rav Sheshet.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked exchange names Rav Assi bar Chama speaking to Rava. Its final reply gives Rav Sheshet’s explanation. Hyman reports a different transmitter and addressee from Dikdukei Soferim.

[Heilprin’s Rav Assi bar Chama headword](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=624&lang=en) directs readers to Yosef bar Chama. Hyman reports a variant in which Yosef bar Chama, identified as Rava’s father, speaks to Rabbah.
